# يَصْطَبِغَ (yaṣṭabiḡa) /jasˤ.tˤa.bi.ɣa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَبَغَ (iṣṭabaḡa)
# يَصْطَبِغْ (yaṣṭabiḡ) /jasˤ.tˤa.biɣ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِصْطَبَغَ (iṣṭabaḡa)
